title: Snail Games to Present at the H.C. Wainwright 28th Annual Global Investment Conference on Monday, September 14, 2026, at 4:00 p.m. ET
summary: CULVER CITY, Calif., Sept. 10, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Snail, Inc. (Nasdaq: SNAL) ("Snail Games"), a leading independent global developer and publisher of interactive digital entertainment, today announced it will be presenting and holding one-on-one meetings at the H.C.
body_markdown:
CULVER CITY, Calif., Sept. 10, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) --[Snail, Inc.](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=tDc6ZOZiYKLAKODmOeu5RbqDn4izTalGBkzuGBg1Fgd5-sHfb2G762ZpRt1uv-wz9f1GGxLAlpBhNkbkLi5esw==) **(Nasdaq:**[SNAL](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=tm-qqFifcU-DolqvlQMIcWMKQKTO5GuBjn3xkVUqQ4CXSzSPoW5QiCV_WMEcB8lQGWepf8w6s7p_-STMMAgefMcolptfT06lBdXHA0cxF8Y=) **) ("Snail Games")** , a leading independent global developer and publisher of interactive digital entertainment, today announced it will be presenting and holding one-on-one meetings at the H.C. Wainwright 28th Annual Global Investment Conference. The conference is being held on September 14-16, 2026, at the Lotte New York Palace Hotel, New York City.


Snail Games’ management is scheduled to present on Monday, September 14, 2026, at 4:00 p.m. Eastern time. Snail Games’ management will also be available for one-on-one meetings during the conference.


The presentation will be available for viewing online via webcast[here](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=R6yGrxwl35y5VK2QnWMqiGEO5cIClqrYtp20349q2qmakmr8hioGRZaVEseR4ZRdOt9rZR6B73fVT95NPyxXOoadM0qWMd8_C7Hr1S3vwS23VgZR-c1lGkXeAz4-9hNyzvORqsOUthM3rriJCteSBQ==) .


**About Snail, Inc.**
Snail, Inc. (Nasdaq: SNAL) is a leading global independent developer and publisher of interactive digital entertainment for consumers around the world, with a premier portfolio of premium games designed for use on a variety of platforms, including consoles, PCs, and mobile devices. For more information, please visit:[https://snail.com/](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=n4BDAm7azgcZY-4jIi42e57IVX40k0308axEnzHngVRgNe1R0thnGTWyNP0ZsCstBIS9wzBgj-Rl1oIlDMQcxg==) .


**About H.C. Wainwright & Co.**
H.C. Wainwright is a full‐service investment bank dedicated to providing corporate finance, strategic advisory and related services to public and private companies across multiple sectors and regions. H.C. Wainwright & Co. also provides research and sales and trading services to institutional investors.
For more information visit H.C. Wainwright & Co. at[www.hcwco.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=PK-_KgZZMWaRt9RfxkVWNd60I6lN3kVCQ--AXwkftMKOySaJKNT6KbhWZ4VFlzIp8l99wHw9CB3ySJ0syOAzuQ==) .
